C0551.title: No‑Name Online Store’s Double 11 Subsidy Scam: Empty Parcels Marked “Empty”
C0551.summary: In December 2025, an online store suddenly experienced a surge in orders during the Double 11 shopping festival, but the parcels were marked “empty.” Organizer Han recruited people to place orders using empty parcels to earn commissions, making 50 yuan per order, forming a criminal chain of false transactions to defraud the platform of subsidies.

references.title: Unknown Online Store Suddenly 'Explodes with Orders' on Singles' Day, But Packages Marked as 'Empty'! This Subsidy Fraud...
